thread:
maya: Heads up — several docs PRs sitting without reviewers. Migration guide (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462) and SDK snippets (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459) need owners. Can we assign reviewers and decide merge window? cc @oliver @sam @harini

oliver: I'm OOO tomorrow but can review the migration guide if someone else picks the SDK snippets. @sam?

sam: I can take SDK snippets. quick question — do we want a full code example or minimal snippet for the JS and Python sections?

maya: Minimal + runnable example for both. Keep the JS example as an async streaming note. Target: lightweight.

docs-bot: CI status for PR #462: docs-preview failed for broken internal link. Logs: 1 broken link: /v1/dedicated -> 404. See preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/preview/462

harini: I'll fix the link in the guide (typo in href). If @oliver can review after I push the fix we should be OK.

oliver: Sounds good. @maya can you add the PRs to the reviewer rota sheet? (link https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/rota)

maya: Added both PRs to the sheet and assigned tentative owners: migration guide -> @harini then @oliver; SDK snippets -> @sam then @anna. Merge window preferred: Friday 10-12 PT so we get CI landings before weekend.

ryan: Docs-preview link for SDK PR? I couldn't find it.

sam: SDK PR preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/preview/459. It shows examples rendering but failing linter: JS snippet missing import line.

anna: I'll pair with @sam on the linter fix tomorrow morning.

maya: Action items: 1) @harini fix link in #462; 2) @oliver review afterwards; 3) @sam add import + run linter; 4) @anna quick follow-up review; 5) aim to merge during Fri 10-12 PT. Can ops/eng-sre hold off on rollouts until Monday? just in case.

eng-sre-bot: Noted. We'll delay non-critical infra syncs until Monday if labeled "docs-delayed-rollout".

sam: I'll push the linter fix in ~45m and ping here.

harini: Fix pushed for #462 — removed bad href. Preview now: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/preview/462 — CI shows green for preview, but staging build still needs final check.

oliver: Reviewing now. Small nits but nothing blocking. Approving in GitHub.

maya: Thanks all — if nothing else blocks I'll merge on Friday during the window. :thumbsup:
